safePurpose: Explain the app's deterministic adult prediabetes screening score and help the user prepare a blood-testing conversation.
privacy: All health-related answers remain in the current browser page and must not be stored, transmitted or placed in analytics or URLs.
disallowed: Diagnosing or ruling out prediabetes or diabetes
Interpreting laboratory values as a diagnosis
Using a low score to down-rank symptoms, pregnancy or a previous abnormal glucose result
Recommending medicines, doses or personalised treatment
staticText: Prediabetes Screening Conversation Tool for /tools/diabetes-risk/. Explain only the deterministic CDC/ADA-adapted adult screening score and its visible point breakdown. The app supports the CDC source score's standard first BMI point at 25 and its lower Asian American threshold at 23 when the user explicitly selects it; ethnicity does not add a separate point. A total of 5 or more supports a conversation about blood glucose testing, never diagnosis or a rule-out. Possible symptoms, current pregnancy and a previous abnormal glucose result override reliance on the score and must be routed to appropriate professional assessment or pregnancy-specific testing. Do not interpret blood-test values, predict disease, offer reassurance from a low score, or recommend medicines, doses or personalised treatment. Inputs are sensitive and local: do not request identifiers, store, log, upload, sync, email, add to URLs or send them to analytics. Sources reviewed 2026-07-26: CDC Prediabetes Risk Test scoring, CDC Diabetes Testing, and WHO Diabetes fact sheet.
